products.processing: 20 m EPSG:32722 event bounding window + 300 m; Sentinel-2 L2A SCL classes 4/5/6/7 retained; NDVI/NDMI only on clear pixels; B04/B08 bilinear, B11/SCL nearest; COG window reads only
products.timestamp_note: datetime is acquisition observation time; created/updated are Earth Search catalogue record timestamps, not the satellite processor's processing time

raw_band_window.recomputation: effective asset scale/offset from archived raw STAC Item; earthsearch:boa_offset_applied typed bool true yields effective offset 0; SCL classes 4/5/6/7 retained for indices

products.calibration_correction: Recomputed from bounded raw COG windows using the source-confirmed earthsearch:boa_offset_applied=true (effective offset 0). Prior receipt recorded -0.1; old and recomputed summary values are compared explicitly. Same scenes/dates/grid; not new event analysis.
products.numeric_summary_comparison_note: Old and verified-offset recomputed summaries are compared; same scene/date/grid, no new acquisitions.

map_overlay.mask_policy: strict SCL classes [4,5,6]; nodata/non-finite RGB alpha=0; SCL nearest-neighbor

map_overlay.pixel_registration: north-up affine raster; bounds are outer pixel edges; source 20 m pixel centers mapped from EPSG:32722 affine

interpretation.support: Official DETER mapped alert polygons provide external registry support for mapped vegetation disturbance at their observation dates; TerraBrasilis describes these data as experimental and subject to change.
interpretation.not_accuracy: These polygons are not independent blind validation of DETER, nor proof of exact clearing onset, cause, or complete coverage.
interpretation.nisar: Selected polygons are geographically outside the compact sparse/dense prepared NISAR AOI. They are regional leads only; no NISAR/SAR detection or signal is claimed.
interpretation.optical_status: Per-event cached paired optical review is reported in targeted_falsification: relative localized decreases are supported for 31637 and 26062, while 23558 is registry-only because nearby rings change similarly. This is not confirmation of complete clearing or onset.

targeted_falsification.method: cached NPZ only; no network calls; before/after paired common-valid SCL; polygon vs 60–120 m and 120–240 m rings; strict 4/5/6 and expanded 4/5/6/7 masks; pre-only NDVI matching

evidence_observations.literal_rgb_observation: Before: visible brown/open mosaic is already present within the outlined polygon. After: the outlined area looks more brown/open; the change is not a uniform new-clearing signature.

calibrated_assessment.statement: Paired NDVI/NDMI decrease is materially greater inside the already partly brown/open DETER polygon than both adjacent rings and pre-NDVI-matched ring pixels. Supports localized cover change relative to nearby seasonal change; does not support a claim of a fresh, uniform clearing or exact onset.
calibrated_assessment.confidence: moderate for localized optical cover decrease; low for complete clearing, cause, or exact event timing

evidence_observations.causal_limit: INPE DETER view_date is associated image observation date, not guaranteed disturbance onset; optical change is not proof of clearing cause.

comparisons.ring_distance_method: Euclidean distance from 20 m pixel center to actual projected DETER polygon boundary; rings exclude event mask; approximate at raster support.
comparisons.common_valid_rule: pixel must pass selected SCL policy and have finite NDVI+NDMI on both dates; same pixel locations used before/after.

evidence_observations.literal_rgb_observation: Before: the outlined patch looks greener overall. After: it appears more brown/open. The before image already has texture/variation; RGB alone does not establish onset or complete clearing.

calibrated_assessment.statement: Polygon NDVI/NDMI decrease exceeds both nearby rings and pre-NDVI-matched ring pixels, but the background also browns substantially. Supports an additional localized cover decrease, not a fresh, uniform clearing interpretation.
calibrated_assessment.confidence: moderate for additional localized optical cover decrease; low for complete clearing, cause, or exact event timing
